paragraphs.text: The Dragon Stronghold is a plane described in Dragon+ Magazine . It is a benthic realm of seawater, and at its center was a magical cold fire. It was the abode of the Scarzam dragons and the place where Sivitri Scarzam learned to harness her magical powers.

In a single catastrophic event, the entire population of Scarzam dragons was summoned by Gydolien Mor and Chondeah to be killed by Sol'Kanar . Only the single largest one survived, on which Sivitri was mounted. It is not known whether the two returned to the Stronghold afterward, or if the realm even holds any life at all now.
↑ Jack C. Harris & Alexander Glass. (1996). The dragon war: a legend of Sol'kanar the swamp king. Dakkon Blackblade . Armada
